headline: Jindal SAW builds 300,000-tonne seamless pipe plant in Abu Dhabi
hook: UAE's first PQF seamless pipe facility
summary: Jindal SAW is establishing a 300,000-tonne seamless pipe manufacturing plant in Abu Dhabi. The project will be the UAE's first facility of its kind using PQF technology and the second in the MENA region. Indian retail investors should note this expansion as it strengthens the company's international manufacturing footprint in the Middle East. The venture expands the firm's operational capacity in a key overseas market.
why_it_matters: Expands global manufacturing footprint for the Indian pipe maker
winners_losers: Jindal SAW gains / regional rivals challenged

headline: Jindal Saw reports 69% drop in Q2 profit despite 6% revenue growth
hook: Costs outpace revenue at Jindal Saw
summary: Jindal Saw posted a net profit of ₹47 crore for the second quarter, marking a 69% year-on-year decline due to surging expenses. Revenue from operations grew 6% during the same period, but EBITDA dropped 42% to ₹261 crore. The contraction in margins reflects rising cost pressures impacting bottom-line profitability for the pipe manufacturer. Indian retail investors holding the stock face margin contraction concerns despite top-line growth.
why_it_matters: Rising expenses compress margins despite revenue growth.
winners_losers: Jindal Saw holders hurt / raw material suppliers gain
